name: YaCy Search Server Self-Hosted
free_limit: GPL-2.0-or-later open-source decentralized and standalone search server; self-hosted crawling, indexing and querying with no vendor-imposed document or query quota.
watch_out: Run and maintain your own Java 17+ server or Docker container, persistent index and storage; compute/bandwidth are not free. Secure the default admin credentials before exposing a node; GPL obligations apply when redistributing.
